sql:
SELECT
  ps.cluster_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.posting_key)
FROM
  posting_skills AS ps
JOIN
  fct_posting AS fp
ON
  ps.posting_key = fp.posting_key
WHERE
  fp.remote_us = TRUE
GROUP BY
  ps.cluster_label;
